title: Onboard arcus-14b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Ava Chen
description: Onboard arcus-14b-v1.0 into the model registry with curated metadata, validated performance profiles for supported instance types, and automated changelog/release-note generation. Motivation: arcus-14b shows promising throughput/quality trade-offs for our medium-latency tier; adding it to the registry enables customers to select a well-profiled 14B model with recommended quantization and batching knobs. Changes include: 1) metadata entry (model card, tags, recommended quantization profiles, supported sequence lengths); 2) performance profiles for GPUs (A10G, A100-40G, H100-80G) with measured tokens/sec, p99 latency, and memory footprints; 3) CI workflow additions to emit changelog entries and update the public model catalog automatically when a model is marked stable; 4) tests and validation harness updates (perf regression checks and a small eval suite for adequacy). This PR includes a short rollout plan: enable model in dev catalog, monitor perf/regressions for 48h, and then promote to stable. Checklist: [x] model metadata schema validated, [x] perf profiles generated from benchmark-lab runs, [x] changelog automation step added, [x] unit and integration tests added, [x] docs updated with example SDK call. See linked Linear ENG-7421 for benchmarking details and SUP-881 for customer request context.

review_conversation: PR review focused on perf profile validity and automation safety. Diego: please confirm H100 numbers were run with the same padding/seq distribution as other models; requested an additional run with 2-shot prompts to validate KV cache impact. Author (Ava): added the 2-shot run and updated h100 profile; flagged noise bands in the perf artifacts and included pctl-based confidence intervals. Priya: requested that changelog workflow only run on a stable tag or when a label 'publish-model' is present; updated workflow to gate on label. Liam: minor doc nits and asked to include an example of the SDK call with recommended batching. After addressing comments, reviewers approved and CI passed.
